title: Pure Phantom Knights
summary: The Phantom Knights cards with the generic DARK Xyz Dragons their Rank-Up-Magics name, plus generic staples. Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons isn't out in the TCG until 12 November 2026. The Chaos Origins cards lead, and the page's 1-card starter runs on them. Doomed Soleret summons itself on an empty field and Sets Umbrage Veil, which can be activated that turn as a Level 3 body. Those two become Malevolent Scythe, which pulls Decayed Cloak from the Deck to search another Phantom Knight. The Rank-Up-Magics climb into Dark Requiem Xyz Dragon, and the Traps revive the Knights from the GY on the opponent's turn.

exclude.Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.

main: The Phantom Knights of Doomed Soleret
Newest support. Summons itself on an empty field and Sets a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap; from the GY, raises two Level/Rank 3s.
The Phantom Knights of Decayed Cloak
Newest support. Reveals a Knight to summon itself and searches a Phantom Knights monster; lets an Xyz be Xyz material by its Rank.
The Phantom Knights of Torn Scales
Discards to mill a Phantom Knights card; revives when another is banished.
The Phantom Knights of Silent Boots
Summons itself next to a Knight; from the GY, searches a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap.
The Phantom Knights of Ancient Cloak
From the GY, searches a Phantom Knights card.
The Phantom Knights of Stained Greaves
Joins when a Knight is summoned; from the GY, summons another.
The Phantom Knights of Ragged Gloves
From the GY, mills a Phantom Knights card.
The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem
Newest support. Revives a Knight and ranks a DARK Xyz up into a Phantom Knights or Xyz Dragon.
Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Force
Banishes DARK monsters to rank a DARK Xyz up by that many.
The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Launch
Quick-Play: ranks a DARK Xyz with no material up by one.
The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil
Newest support. Live the turn it is Set: becomes a Level 3 body; from the GY, Xyz Summons a DARK Xyz on the spot.
Phantom Knights' Fog Blade
Negates a monster; from the GY, revives a Knight.
The Phantom Knights of Shade Brigandine
Becomes a Level 4 body, live the turn it is Set.
The Phantom Knights of Tomb Shield
Becomes a Level 3 body; from the GY, negates a Trap.
The Phantom Knights of Mist Claws
Returns a banished Knight; from the GY, summons on a direct attack.
The Phantom Knights of Wrong Magnetring
Negates an attack and becomes a body that draws two.
Raider's Unbreakable Mind
Counts as Phantom Knights: destroys a card whenever you rank up a DARK Xyz.
extra: The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe
Newest support. Rank 3: summons a Knight from the Deck; searches a Rank-Up-Magic when you make an Xyz Dragon.
The Phantom Knights of Break Sword
Rank 3: destroys one of yours and one of theirs; revives two Knights.
The Phantom Knights of Rusty Bardiche
Link-3: mills a Knight to Set a Phantom Knights Spell/Trap, and destroys when a DARK Xyz lands next to it.
The Phantom Knights of Cursed Javelin
Rank 2: zeroes and negates a monster.
Rank 4: ranks up or down into another Phantom Knights or Xyz Dragon.
Generic Rank 3 from the same set: attaches banished Traps and revives a DARK monster.
Generic Rank 4 DARK Dragon: halves a monster's ATK.
Rank 5 on Dark Rebellion: negates a monster effect and revives an Xyz.
